bodies: American Association for Marriage and Family Therapy
Association of Marital and Family Therapy Regulatory Boards

exams.name: Registered Play Therapist
exams.blurb: Credential for licensed mental health professionals who complete play therapy instruction and supervised play therapy client contact hours.

exams.name: Registered Play Therapist-Supervisor
exams.blurb: Advanced play therapy designation authorising holders to supervise other clinicians pursuing the Registered Play Therapist credential.

exams.name: Certified Child Life Specialist
exams.blurb: Credential for professionals supporting children coping with hospitalisation and illness, requiring an internship and a national examination.

exams.name: Certified School Social Work Specialist
exams.blurb: NASW speciality credential for master-level social workers practising in schools, requiring supervised school-based experience and references.

exams.name: Nationally Certified School Psychologist
exams.blurb: National school psychology credential requiring a NASP-approved specialist degree, a 1,200-hour internship and the Praxis School Psychologist test.

exams.name: AAMFT Approved Supervisor
exams.body: American Association for Marriage and Family Therapy
exams.blurb: Designation for experienced marriage and family therapists who complete supervision coursework and mentored supervision of supervision.

exams.name: AMFTRB National Marital and Family Therapy Examination
exams.body: Association of Marital and Family Therapy Regulatory Boards
exams.blurb: Licensure examination for marriage and family therapists covering systemic assessment, treatment planning, therapeutic interventions and legal ethics.

exams.name: Certified Family Life Educator
exams.blurb: National credential for family life education professionals, available by examination or through an approved academic programme pathway.
